messages.content:
Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-transcribe-medium-0109", "row_sha256": "832ff8246740ff3131cd50ae49196a8e8dcb62ee1db482445bdbc565e251a276", "mode": "/transcribe", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Remove true hesitation and accidental restarts. Keep the supplied language.", "input": "um we found the leak on the north block just after the pump started cycling again yesterday morning and the rows near the old pear trees were getting less water than the rest. i walked the line with mara while she listened at each coupling, and she said uh-huh when the hiss got louder beside the third valve. the ground was soft there, but the pipe itself looked intact, so we shut the zone and opened the small access box instead of digging up the row. well, inside, the filter screen was packed with fine grit and one washer had slipped out of its groove. we rinsed the screen in a bucket, seated the washer, and tightened the cap by hand before bringing the pressure back slowly. like we usually do after a repair, mara watched the gauge while i checked the emitters at both ends of the block. the readings settled evenly, and no more water appeared around the box. we left the zone running for ten minutes, then marked the cap with orange tape so the crew can find it during the next inspection. the pears had not been watered evenly that morning, so we wrote down which rows might need another check later in the day.", "output": "We found the leak on the north block just after the pump started cycling again yesterday morning, and the rows near the old pear trees were getting less water than the rest. I walked the line with Mara while she listened at each coupling, and she said, “Uh-huh,” when the hiss got louder beside the third valve. The ground was soft there, but the pipe itself looked intact, so we shut the zone and opened the small access box instead of digging up the row. Well, inside, the filter screen was packed with fine grit, and one washer had slipped out of its groove. We rinsed the screen in a bucket, seated the washer, and tightened the cap by hand before bringing the pressure back slowly. Like we usually do after a repair, Mara watched the gauge while I checked the emitters at both ends of the block. The readings settled evenly, and no more water appeared around the box. We left the zone running for ten minutes, then marked the cap with orange tape so the crew can find it during the next inspection. The pears had not been watered evenly that morning, so we wrote down which rows might need another check later in the day."}]
